card.line: Ephrath, also called Bethlehem, is the city near the road where Rachel died after giving birth to Benjamin, and where Jacob set up her tomb marker.

moments.title: Rachel's hard labor
moments.text: Jacob's family left Bethel, and before they reached Ephrath, Rachel began a difficult labor. The midwife told her not to be afraid, because she was having another son.

moments.title: Rachel dies and is buried
moments.text: Rachel named her son Ben-oni with her last breath, but Jacob called him Benjamin. She was buried on the way to Ephrath, and Jacob set up a pillar on her grave.

moments.title: Jacob remembers Rachel
moments.text: Years later, Jacob told Joseph that Rachel died along the way, some distance from Ephrath. He said he buried her there beside the road, to his sorrow.
